verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence lets an external coding agent drive Bolt's builder directly: there is no Bolt-hosted MCP server, no API (the OpenAPI probes return 404), and only Bolt's own Standard/Max agents are documented. The only indirect route is GitHub-backed projects with automatic commit sync and branch work, which could let an outside agent edit the repo for Bolt to pick up, but the docs do not explicitly confirm that external commits flow back into Bolt. Missing for 10: a first-party way to plug in your own agent (MCP server, API or agent slot), documented two-way sync of externally authored commits, and any hands-on corroboration of such a workflow.
